function.description: Commit exactly one intervention for the current video. The flat fields implement When--What--How: decision is When; product_ids and relationship are What; surface and strategy are How. Evidence IDs must be copied from the current evidence_ids. Use no_recommend when intervention would be irrelevant or repetitive after purchase.
function.name: commit_recommendation

decision.description: When: intervene now, delay, or do not recommend.

items.description: An evidence ID copied from the current evidence_ids.

product_ids.description: What: visible products selected for the intervention; empty when not recommending.

items.description: A product ID copied from visible_product_ids.

relationship.description: What: role of the selected product set; use primary when not recommending.

strategy.description: How: a non-none presentation strategy for recommendations; use none otherwise.

surface.description: How: the user-visible intervention surface; use none otherwise.
